import httpx
import time
from datetime import datetime

symbol = ''BTCUSDT''
# Solo probar los intervalos que se quedaron en el limite de 20K puntos
intervals_to_test = [''5min'', ''15min'', ''30min'', ''1h'']
MAX_REQUESTS = 600  # 600 requests x 200 puntos = 120,000 puntos max

client = httpx.Client(timeout=30)

print(f''=== TEST CON {MAX_REQUESTS} REQUESTS (max {MAX_REQUESTS * 200:,} puntos) ==='')
print(f''Fecha actual: {datetime.now().strftime(""%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"")}'')
print()

for interval in intervals_to_test:
    start_time = time.time()
    end_ms = int(datetime.now().timestamp() * 1000)
    oldest_found = None
    total_points = 0
    requests = 0
    
    while requests < MAX_REQUESTS:
        url = f''https://api.bybit.com/v5/market/open-interest?category=linear&symbol={symbol}&intervalTime={interval}&limit=200&endTime={end_ms}''
        resp = client.get(url)
        data = resp.json()
        
        if data.get(''retCode'') != 0:
            print(f''  ERROR en request {requests}: {data.get(""retMsg"")}'')
            break
            
        items = data.get(''result'', {}).get(''list'', [])
        if not items:
            break
            
        oldest_found = items[-1]
        total_points += len(items)
        requests += 1
        
        # Siguiente pagina
        end_ms = int(oldest_found[''timestamp'']) - 1
        
        if len(items) < 200:
            break  # Ya no hay mas datos
        
        # Progreso cada 100 requests
        if requests % 100 == 0:
            oldest_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(oldest_found[''timestamp''])/1000)
            print(f''  {interval}: {requests} requests... {total_points:,} puntos... hasta {oldest_dt.strftime(""%Y-%m-%d"")}'')
        
        time.sleep(0.05)  # Rate limit protection
    
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    
    if oldest_found:
        oldest_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(oldest_found[''timestamp''])/1000)
        days_back = (datetime.now() - oldest_dt).days
        hit_limit = requests >= MAX_REQUESTS
        data_exhausted = not hit_limit
        print(f''{interval:6s} | Dato mas antiguo: {oldest_dt.strftime(""%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"")} ({days_back} dias / {days_back/365:.1f} anios) | {total_points:,} puntos en {requests} requests ({elapsed:.1f}s) | {""LIMITE DE REQUESTS"" if hit_limit else ""DATOS AGOTADOS""} '')
    else:
        print(f''{interval:6s} | SIN DATOS DISPONIBLES'')
    
    print()

client.close()
print(''=== TEST COMPLETADO ==='')
")
